components.name: Primary Command
components.description: Starts a capture or the primary empty-state action.
components.css: .ds-command-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #2f6fed; border-radius: 8px; background: #2f6fed; color: #fff; font: 600 12px/1 Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-command-primary:hover { background: #245fd8; border-color: #245fd8; } .ds-command-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(47,111,237,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Command
components.description: Keeps capture, export, and secondary commands readable.
components.css: .ds-command { height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #202124; font: 600 12px/1 Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-command:hover { border-color: #d5dce7; background: #eef2f8; } .ds-command:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(47,111,237,.32); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Undo / Redo Control
components.description: The only icon-only controls in the top command bar.
components.css: .ds-history-command { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #202124; cursor: pointer; } .ds-history-command:hover { border-color: #d5dce7; background: #eef2f8; } .ds-history-command:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(47,111,237,.32); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-history-command svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Annotation Dock
components.description: Detached whiteboard-style toolbar for markup and tool properties.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: flex; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #d5dce7; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(32,33,36,.16); } .ds-tool { width: 58px; height: 58px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; padding: 5px 3px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #687386; font: 600 10px/1 Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-active { border-color: #c9d9ff; background: #e9f0ff; color: #2f6fed; } .ds-tool-icon { font-size: 18px; } .ds-tool kbd { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #687386; font: 9px/1 Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; }

components.name: Neutral Surface
components.description: A quiet container for history, settings, and empty-state actions.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #d5dce7; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #202124; box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(32,33,36,.18); } .ds-surface p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #687386; font: 400 14px/1.5 Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
CleanShot W is a quiet Windows utility that keeps the captured screenshot as the visual authority. The editor gives the image generous neutral space, then brings annotation tools together in a detached whiteboard-style dock at the bottom. Export and sharing stay close to the top command bar, where they are readable at a glance rather than hidden behind ambiguous icons.

The system is native-feeling, compact, and functional. The capture overlay is a separate surface with a darkened screen, a high-contrast selection frame, dimensions, and a direct Cancel action. It does not carry instructional copy or a decorative workspace texture.
keyCharacteristics: Screenshot-first neutral canvas with generous breathing room.
Text-led command bar; Undo and Redo are the only icon-only top controls.
Detached, labeled annotation dock with intuitive single-key shortcuts.
Light Windows-native surfaces with restrained borders and ambient depth.

rules.name: The Clear Canvas Rule
rules.body: The screenshot and its markup own the visual focus; neutral space supports them and never becomes a decorative scene.

rules.name: The One-Voice Label Rule
rules.body: Tool labels and command labels should be short, literal, and paired with a visible shortcut or state when that improves recall.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are white or cool neutral; depth appears only where a surface floats above the screenshot workspace.

dos: Do keep sharing and export commands visible and text-labeled in the top bar.
Do center the screenshot with neutral breathing room around it.
Do use flyouts, dialogs, or popovers for history and settings instead of persistent sidebars.
donts: Don't add a warm desk, blueprint grid, or other decorative workspace surface behind the screenshot.
Don't add icon-only export, sharing, save, or settings controls to the top bar.
Don't put instructional help strips in the capture overlay.
